name: app-lavender-gradient-meet-the-team-slide
title: Lavender Meet the Team Slide
whatItIs: A lavender gradient slide with a two-tone 'Meet the Team' heading and three circular duotone portraits connected by a dashed curving path, each with name and role.
whatItMeans: A path linking the portraits adds a sense of journey and collaboration, and the duotone photos keep everyone in a consistent style.
techniques: Portraits placed on a diagonal dashed path
Two-tone heading with faded first word
Gradient darker at the top fading to white

vocabulary.definition: A dashed line linking items in a route-like way.
A photo tinted with a single colour range.
A soft circular border around an avatar.
